_comment: Shared defaults for workflow records. Phase 2 overrides these per workflow.
required_inputs: relevant artifact, immutable revision or environment reference
dependencies: A phase cannot start until its entry criteria and predecessor evidence are accepted; independent read-only analysis may run in parallel against the same immutable baseline.
parallel_tasks: Independent QA and security analysis may run in parallel after scope is frozen; both must cite the same candidate revision.
communication_plan: Publish phase status, decision owner, customer/operational impact and next update time at each gate; communicate material risk immediately.
completion_criteria: Every required phase has accepted exit evidence or a valid, time-bound waiver approved by the designated authority; residual risk and operational ownership are accepted.
